QuestInfo.name: [Limina] The Erda Surges
QuestInfo.0: You defeated Hilla in the Labyrinth of Suffering Deep Core. Now it's time for you to carry on toward the Black Mage.
QuestInfo.1: The Labyrinth Core has vanished, and something new has appeared. But before you investigate that, you need to follow Orchid. There's a lot going on here.
QuestInfo.2: An image of Guwaru appeared from the broken mask. You've got more than a few questions for Guwaru.
